name: Relay Guardian
method: Direct visual review of four images; file/alpha validation separate from structural approval.
confirmed: Single sonar dish with cyan concave front, bronze ribbed rear and narrow bowl profiles.
Dark bronze diving-suit armor, ribbed hoses, lead boots and cyan joint accents preserved.
Rear knee flexion gaps and heel blocks differentiated from front.
limitations: Profiles show cyan face as a broad luminous strip rather than thin ring intersections; reconcile dish depth and ring projection.
Hose endpoints and neck bracket geometry need common construction map across all views.
Far limbs fully occluded in profiles; separate hidden parts needed for rigging.
Finger counts and joint axes not established by references.
Top dish attachment has tight margin; normalize scale and baseline before sprite production.
Patina, rivets and backing rib placement vary between images.
next: Align dish cross-section and hose mounts, define hidden limbs and fixed joints, then separate parts and animate sonar emission as runtime VFX.
